     3	## Description
     4	
     5	Add frontend API client methods to call the notes display settings GET and PUT endpoints from the browser.
     6	
     7	## Scope
     8	
     9	- `gui/public/js/api.js` — add api.config.notesDisplay.get() and api.config.notesDisplay.set(data) methods

    17	1. api.config.notesDisplay.get() is defined and calls GET /api/config/notes-display via the existing request() helper

   668	/**
   669	 * A workspace entry within a {@link NotesResponse} project group.
   670	 *
   671	 * The Go backend serialises struct fields using their Go-style capitalised
   672	 * names (`WorkspaceId`, `Notes`). Future serialiser changes may emit
   673	 * lowercase equivalents (`workspaceId`, `notes`). View code **must**
   674	 * normalise both casings:
   675	 *
   676	 * ```js
   677	 * const wid   = ws.WorkspaceId || ws.workspaceId || '';
   678	 * const notes = ws.Notes       ?? ws.notes       ?? '';
   679	 * ```

   681	 * @typedef {Object} NotesWorkspace
   682	 * @property {string} [WorkspaceId] - Workspace ID (Go-capitalised key).
   683	 * @property {string} [workspaceId] - Workspace ID (lowercase key).
   684	 * @property {string} [Notes]       - Free-text notes; empty string when none (Go-capitalised key).
   685	 * @property {string} [notes]       - Free-text notes; empty string when none (lowercase key).

   688	/**
   689	 * A project entry within a {@link NotesResponse}.

   691	 * The Go backend serialises struct fields using their Go-style capitalised
   692	 * names (`ProjectId`, `ProjectName`, `Workspaces`). Future serialiser changes
   693	 * may emit lowercase equivalents. View code **must** normalise both casings:
   694	 *
   695	 * ```js
   696	 * const id   = p.ProjectId   || p.projectId   || '';
   697	 * const name = p.ProjectName || p.projectName || id;
   698	 * ```
   699	 *
   700	 * @typedef {Object} NotesProject
